lines.text: Three families on the west road this week. Walking, not trading. They don't stop here. They look at our wall, and they keep walking east.
Burned villages, they say. Far west, past the river country. And they all say the same strange thing about the armies: that they weren't men. Then they stop talking and walk faster.
I'm writing it down. Dates, names, directions. Somebody in this town should be keeping a record that isn't gossip. Might as well be the one who patrols anyway.
